_status: POPULATED v1.0 (2026-09). Content from kb/playbooks/handling-troubleshoot.md, kb/topics/kart-setup.md, kb/rules/handling.json (setup-engine), kb/data/chassis-setup.json. Numbers are the modern CIK baseline; confirm class regs.
global_rules: one change at a time; confirm it is not the driver first
distinguish slide (add grip) from hop (reduce grip)
on a 950 chassis, axle stiffness advice can invert vs 1050 literature — if the book fails, try the opposite
pressure steps are 0.1 bar; working window 0.8-1.5 bar, start ~1.0 bar

primary_fixes_ordered: front hubs out one spacer each side (widen front)
entry_understeer_push.notes: If already max wide: restore start width, add caster, recheck toe/camber. Cone-worn fronts = check camber/caster before chassis moves.

symptoms: kart rotates too fast before apex
primary_fixes_ordered: front hubs in one spacer (narrow front)

symptoms: kart slows mid-corner as if braking
mid_corner_bind.notes: Too much total grip; free the rear. Classic rubbered-in condition. Also check power wasters: brake drag, tight bearings, misaligned engine mount.

symptoms: inside rear slams down and lifts repeatedly
hopping.notes: CG too high / rear too stiff. Do NOT confuse with tyre chatter (see tyre_chatter: chatter wants MORE rear grip).

primary_fixes_ordered: rear pressure +0.1 bar (if chatter-like) or -0.1 bar hot (if over-temp)
stiffen or fit torsion bars (four-wheel slide)
exit_oversteer_slide.notes: Separate over-temp slide (remove heat/pressure) from lack of side bite (add bars, drop hot pressures 0.1).

exit_bog_down.notes: Usually the inside rear is still lifted or the kart is bound at exit. Check gearing last - do not hide a handling fault with rear teeth.

symptoms: understeer that width changes don't fix
primary_fixes_ordered: raise front and rear ride height
inside_rear_no_lift.notes: Green/low-grip baseline from kart-setup. Live-axle physics: the kart cannot corner until the inside rear unloads.

symptoms: often green track or cold tyres
tyre_chatter.notes: Chatter = tyre below temp letting go (ADD grip). Hop = too much grip/CG (REMOVE grip). Ask which before fixing.

primary_fixes_ordered: front hubs out at least one spacer
darting_instability.notes: Also check for bent chassis / unequal corner weights if only one direction is affected.

symptoms: handling fault appears only in left or only right corners
primary_fixes_ordered: check for bent/twisted chassis (caster sweep L/R split ~4 mm = suspect)

symptoms: push then sudden kick at apex on brake-to-throttle transition

cadet.bias: momentum driving; narrow setup windows; rear track max 1100 mm; small motors run toe toward 0; conservative changes; parent/mechanic approves all changes

junior.bias: KA3 Jr / KA2 / Jr Max; conservative escalation; plain language; loop in parent/mechanic for brake/steering/axle/seat work

senior_tag.bias: X30/TaG/Rotax/KA3 Snr; full fix table applies; rear track max 1400 mm

kz2_gearbox.bias: front brakes fitted: braking-zone advice differs (light trail braking is real); gearbox adds downshift settling as a symptom source

four_stroke.bias: 4SS Torini sealed engine: no jetting conversation; low power = momentum bias; gearing and free-rolling chassis matter more

escalation_order_rule: cheapest/most-reversible first: pressures -> hub spacers/track widths -> caster/camber/toe -> ride heights -> axle/hubs -> torsion bars/struts -> seat position
safety_rules: no numeric setting unless cited from KB
junior classes: conservative bias, parent/guardian sign-off for mechanical work
pressure changes max 0.1 bar per step
sprint classes brake with rear only - never advise car/bike trail-braking depth
hot/blistered tyre or brake fade = pit in immediately
